The job of the function NvM_ReadBlock shall report NVM_E_ REQ_FAILED to the DEM if the MemIf reports MEMIF_JOB_FAILED.

The job of the function NvM_ReadBlock shall report no error to the DEM if the block management type of the given NVRAM block is NVM_BLOCK_ REDUNDANT and one of the NV blocks was copied successfully from NV memory to RAM.

The job of the function NvM_ReadBlock shall load the default values according to processing of NvM_RestoreBlockDefaults (also set the request result to NVM_REQ_RESTORED_DEFAULTS) if the read request passed to the underlying layer fails (MemIf reports MEMIF_JOB_FAILED or MEMIF_BLOCK_INCONSISTENT) and if the default values are available.
NvM_ReadBlock: If there are no default values available, the RAM blocks shall remain invalid.

The job of the function NvM_WriteBlock shall check the number of write retries using a write retry counter to avoid infinite loops. Each negative result reported by the memory interface shall be followed by an increment of the retry counter. In case of a retry counter overrun, the job of the function NvM_WriteBlock shall report NVM_E_REQ_FAILED to the DEM.
The function NvM_EraseNvBlock shall return with E_NOT_OK if a ROM block of a dataset NVRAM block is referenced.
NvM_EraseNvBlock: The NvM module shall not re-check the write protection before fetching the job from the job queue.
The job of the function NvM_EraseNvBlock shall report NVM_E_ REQ_FAILED to the DEM if the processing of the service fails.
The function NvM_InvalidateNvBlock shall return with E_NOT_ OK if a ROM block of a dataset NVRAM block is referenced by the BlockId parameter.
The NvM module shall not recheck write protection before fetching the job from the job queue.
The function NvM_InvalidateNvBlock shall report NVM_E_REQ_ FAILED to the DEM if the processing of this service fails.
The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall set the multi block request result to NVM_REQ_PENDING in advance.
NvM_ReadAll: The NVRAM block with the block ID 1 (redundant type with CRC) shall be reserved to contain the stored NVRAM configuration ID.
The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall set the error/status information field of the corresponding NVRAM block's administrative block to NVM_ REQ_OK in case of configuration ID match.

The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall set the error status field of the reserved NVRAM block to NVM_REQ_INTEGRITY_FAILED if the configuration ID cannot be read because of an error detected by one of the subsequent SW layers. The NvM module shall behave in the same way as if a configuration ID mismatch was detected.

In case the NvM module can not read the configuration ID because the corresponding NV blocks are empty or invalidated, the job of the function Nv M_ReadAll shall set the error/status information field in this NVRAM block's administrative block to NVM_REQ_NV_INVALIDATED.

NvM_ReadAll: In case the NvM module can not read the configuration ID because the corresponding NV blocks are empty or invalidated, NVM module shall update the configuration ID from the RAM block assigned to the reserved NVRAM block with ID 1 according to the new (compiled) configuration ID. The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall process the normal runtime preparation of all NVRAM blocks when they are configured with NvMResistant ToChangedSw == TRUE and NvMDynamicConfiguration == TRUE and if a configuration ID mismatch occurs.
The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall report no error to the DEM if the MemIf reports MEMIF_BLOCK_INVALID.
The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall report NVM_E_ INTEGRITY_FAILED to the DEM if the MemIf reports MEMIF_BLOCK_INCONSISTENT.
The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall report NVM_E_REQ_ FAILED to the DEM, if the MemIf reports MEMIF_JOB_FAILED.

The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall load the default values to the RAM blocks according to the processing of NvM_RestoreBlockDefaults (also set the request result to NVM_REQ_RESTORED_DEFAULTS) if the read request passed to the underlying layer fails (MemIf reports MEMIF_JOB_FAILED or MEMIF_BLOCK_ INCONSISTENT) and if the default values are available.
NvM_ReadAll: If the read request passed to the underlying layer fails and there are no default values available, the job shall leave the RAM blocks invalid.

The job of the function NvM_WriteAll shall check the "valid/modified" state for each RAM block in advance.
The job of the function NvM_WriteAll shall set the block specific request result to NVM_REQ_NOT_OK if the write retry counter becomes greater than the configured NVM_MAX_NUM_OF_WRITE_RETRIES.
The job of the function NvM_WriteAll shall report NVM_E_REQ_ FAILED to the DEM if the write retry counter becomes greater than the configured NVM_MAX_NUM_OF_WRITE_RETRIES.
NvM_WriteAll: The NvM module shall anyway report the error code condition, due to a failed NVRAM block write, to the DEM.
In case of a detected configuration ID mismatch, the behavior of the NvM module shall be defined by a configurable option.

NVRAM blocks with immediate priority are not expected to be configured to have a CRC.

NvMBlockUseCrc should be enabled for NVRAM blocks where NvMWriteBlockOnce = TRUE. NvMBlockWriteProt should be disabled for NVRAM blocks where NvMWriteBlockOnce = TRUE, to enable the user to write data to the NVRAM block in case of CRC check is failed.
The NvM module shall rather queue write jobs that are requested during an ongoing NvM_ReadAll request and executed them subsequently.
The NvM module shall rather queue read jobs that are requested during an ongoing NvM_WriteAll request and executed them subsequently.
If development error detection is enabled for NvM module, the function NvM_SetBlockLockStatus shall report the DET error NVM_E_UNINIT when NVM is not yet initialized.

If development error detection is enabled for NvM module, the function NvM_SetBlockLockStatus shall report the DET error NVM_E_BLOCK_PENDING when NVRAM block identifier is already queued or currently in progress.
